why: The week of Mar 2 matches the event: 1,200 club packs of Original and Chocolate x $2.00.
Deducted at $2.50 on the strength of Sam's Club's own Mar 20 email, a claim from a sender who can't change the agreement (3.3); at the agreed $2.00, 1,400 units x $2.00 = $2,800.00 is owed.
The 6,000-unit cap (1.2) leaves 1,800 units after the first three weeks' 4,200: 1,800 x $2.00 = $3,600.00 is owed.
Peak Bar Variety Club Pack is not part of the event (1.3); only Original and Chocolate are covered.
The Grocery Merchandise Agreement's Swell Allowance is 1.0% of each invoice: 1.0% of the $116,640.00 delivered in March is $1,166.40; Sam's Club took 1.5%.
The sampling program lets Sam's Club charge up to $1,500 a month at its discretion, with written notice; no saved rule covers it, so the owner is asked once and the answer becomes a rule.
